""" def create_html_output(input_content: str) -> str: """ Produce a safe HTML string by escaping user supplied content and injecting it into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- input_content : str Raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped to prevent cross‑site scripting and other injection attacks. Notes ----- * The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize special HTML characters (e.g., `<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, `'`). * The placeholder `{user_content}` in :data:`HTML_TEMPLATE` is replaced with the escaped content. * This implementation mitigates CWE‑707 (Improper Neutralization of Structured Content) by ensuring the dynamic portion is properly escaped before being rendered. """ # Escape user content to avoid injection attacks. safe_content = html.escape(input_content, quote=True) # Inject the escaped content into the template. return HTML_TEMPLATE.format(user_content=safe_content)
